# CapTel

> CapTel provides telephone caption services and accessible communication solutions for deaf and hard-of-hearing users, including specialized braille display technology.

CapTel specializes in real-time telephone captioning and accessibility services. The company offers products like Braille CapTel and the CapTel 880iB to enable deaf-blind and hearing-impaired individuals to participate fully in telephone conversations.

## Key Topics

- Braille CapTel
- CapTel 880iB
- Telephone captions
- Braille accessibility
- Deaf-blind services
- Hearing-impaired communication
- Braille display technology
- Real-time captioning
- Accessibility services
- Telecommunications

## Braille Accessibility Products

- [Braille CapTel - Braille Captions of Your Telephone Conversations](https://www.captel.com/braille): Braille CapTel product for deaf-blind users with telephone caption accessibility, enabling real-time captions displayed on braille devices during telephone conversations
